hebrewText: וְ/חָמְד֤וּ שָׂדוֹת֙ וְ/גָזָ֔לוּ וּ/בָתִּ֖ים וְ/נָשָׂ֑אוּ וְ/עָֽשְׁקוּ֙ גֶּ֣בֶר וּ/בֵית֔/וֹ וְ/אִ֖ישׁ וְ/נַחֲלָתֽ/וֹ

tokens.kjv: beauty, greatly beloved, covet, delectable thing, ([idiom] great) delight, desire, goodly, lust, (be) pleasant (thing), precious (thing).
country, field, ground, land, soil, [idiom] wild.

tokens.bdb: to pluck off; specifically to flay, strip or rob

Compare H802 (אִשָּׁה).
